questionEn: For the first time in the history of chemistry, Ar-Razi divided substances into what groups?
questionUz: Ar-Roziy kimyo tarixida birinchi marta moddalarni qanday guruhlarga ajratdi?
explanationEn: Al-Razi divided substances into mineral, plant and animal.
explanationUz: Ar-Roziy moddalarni mineral, oʻsimlik va hayvonotga ajratgan.
